class.name: PhysicsServer3DManager
class.description: [PhysicsServer3DManager] is the API for registering [PhysicsServer3D] implementations and for setting the default implementation. [b]Note:[/b] It is not possible to switch physics servers at runtime. This class is only used on startup at the server initialization level, by Godot itself and possibly by GDExtensions.

method.name: register_server
method.description: Register a [PhysicsServer3D] implementation by passing a [param name] and a [Callable] that returns a [PhysicsServer3D] object.

method.name: register_server_with_rendering_device
method.description: Register a [PhysicsServer3D] implementation that uses the GPU, like [method register_server], except that [param create_callback] takes one argument: the main [RenderingDevice], or [code]null[/code] when there is none (the Compatibility renderer, or headless). The [RenderingServer] exists when the physics server is created, but is not yet available as a singleton, so a server that needs the device receives it here.

method.name: set_default_server
method.description: Set the default [PhysicsServer3D] implementation to the one identified by [param name], if [param priority] is greater than the priority of the current default implementation.
